---
title: "Internals"
---

The three pages that follow document the machinery behind the user-facing calls. None of it is
needed to run a scenario. It is needed to extend the stack, to read its source, or to account for
behaviour the packages never announce, such as an input clamped to the edge of its domain.

::: {.chapter-outline}
- [Pipeline architecture](architecture.qmd) — the order of operations inside `run_scenarios`.
- [estiMINT internals](estimint-internals.qmd) — the model bundle, the calibrator, and the monotone sweep.
- [stateMINT internals](statemint-internals.qmd) — the Mamba2 backbone, the input tensor, and the target transforms.
:::

The pages are independent and can be read in any order, though each assumes the user-facing
chapter for the package it describes. Covariates, `dn0`, EIR and the 157-window grid are
taken as given. Please see [Core Concepts](../03-concepts/index.qmd) for all four.
